course.title: AARAMBH Recorded 9th  BATCH
course.description:
1) We'll cover Science, Maths, Social Science, English (Both), Hindi (Both), Information
Technology(IT), Artificial Intelligence (Al), Sanskrit

2) It is a Live Interaction Course.
NOTE: English, Hindi, IT, Al and Sanskrit will be in a Recorded Mode.
3) Backlog Chapter’s recorded lectures will be available + We’ll cover those chapters in a live marathon on Youtube.
4) Class notes will be provided in PDF format for each class on the Next Toppers App.
5) Frequently Tests will be conducted to assess your progress on Completion of certain amount of syllabus.
6) Syllabus will be completed by October End. However, the entire course will remain accessible to you until your final exams in 2026.
7) This Batch is non refundable.
